title: Config
body:
Syntax: config [setting] [on|off]
        config battle ready [<jutsu name> on|off]
        battle ready config

Run CONFIG to see and change your saved personal preferences for automatically looting ryo and gear, auto-sacrificing corpses and displaying tips. Settings persist on your character across logins and server restarts.

Battle Ready has its own saved per-jutsu on/off list: CONFIG BATTLE READY opens the menu, and CONFIG BATTLE READY SAMURAI SABRE ON (for example) enables that ability in the one-command combat preparation. Enabling a selection does not grant the technique: you still need to learn it and pay its normal costs. See HELP BATTLE READY.

Staff have separate options: HELP STAFFCONFIG.
